dct_description_sm: Sri Lanka administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 03. This dataset is structured into 4 levels: - Admin 1: 9 - Admin 2: 25 - Admin 3: 339 - Admin 4: 14043 Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 16 August 2022: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 02 August 2022: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 02 August 2022: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-roap). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
